content.short: A progressive community that is based on true ownership, equality and transparency.
content.description: Osmium DAO aims to create a progressive community that is based on true ownership, equality and transparency by leveraging the potentials and capabilities of DAOs and NFTs. Osmium DAO is meant to represent a professionally managed treasury owned by the community. It aims to create a sustainable, perpetual treasury through various established business models owned directly by the token holders, governed by OsmiumShare NFT holders. The DAO also aims to grow the treasury and pay out dividends in perpetuity.
content.meta: Find out about Osmium DAO (OSM) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
